channel.title: Anthropic Blogcast
channel.description: Anthropic Blogcast turns Anthropic's latest announcements and research posts into listenable episodes — follow the Anthropic blog without reading. Hosted by Alex and Jordan. New episodes whenever Anthropic publishes.
channel.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi
channel.itunes:summary: Anthropic Blogcast turns Anthropic's latest announcements and research posts into listenable episodes — follow the Anthropic blog without reading. Hosted by Alex and Jordan. New episodes whenever Anthropic publishes.

item.title: Episode 1: Claude Sonnet 5.5: The Mid-Tier Just Got Scary Good
item.description: Anthropic's new mid-tier model is scarily good: Alex and Jordan break down Claude Sonnet 5.5's coding chops, its 1M-token context on every tier, and why Epic Games and Rakuten are betting big on it.
item.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi

item.title: Episode 2: Barclays Goes All In on Claude
item.description: Alex and Jordan unpack Barclays' bank-wide Claude rollout: Claude Code for engineers, a million-search knowledge assistant, and 120,000 emails a day.
item.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi

item.title: Episode 3: Building with Claude Sonnet 5.5
item.description: Alex and Jordan break down Anthropic's developer guide to Claude Sonnet 5.5: pricing, model details, migration breaking changes, and tuning tips.
item.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi

item.title: Episode 4: Automating Eval Design and Hillclimbing with Claude
item.description: Alex and Jordan unpack Anthropic's guide to building evaluations and improving against them with the claude-api skill's build-eval and hillclimb commands.
item.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi

item.title: Episode 5: Claude Frontier Academy: Anthropic trains 10,000 engineers
item.description: Anthropic commits $100 million to train 10,000 Frontier Deployed Engineers by the end of 2027, betting the enterprise AI bottleneck is talent, not models.
item.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi

item.title: Episode 6: What a Task Really Costs on Opus 5.5
item.description: Alex and Jordan unpack Anthropic's guide to what really drives Claude Code session costs on Opus 5.5 — effort levels, model choice, cache tricks, and how to measure your own spend.
item.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi

item.title: Episode 7: Claude Code Mods: Token Weather, Blast Radius, and Replay Theater
item.description: Alex and Jordan break down Anthropic's new mods system for Claude Code: JavaScript plugins that draw live UI, hold risky commands, and replay your edits.
item.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi

item.title: Episode 8: Expanding the Cyber Verification Program
item.description: Anthropic gives vetted security teams access to advanced cyber capabilities across three verified tiers
item.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi

item.title: Episode 9: Anthropic's $150M Bet on American Science
item.description: Anthropic commits $150M over three years to the Genesis Mission, bringing Claude to more than fifteen federal agencies.
item.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi

item.title: Episode 10: Anthropic's 2026 Usage Policy: What's Changing
item.description: Alex and Jordan break down Anthropic's 2026 Usage Policy update, effective November 12: a new deceptive-campaigns section, loosened election-targeting rules, new hardware safety requirements, and a narrow ban on model abuse, with what builders need to do before the deadline.
item.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi

item.title: Episode 11: The Anthropic Cyber Mission: AI for the Defenders
item.description: Anthropic launches a long-term Cyber Mission to defend critical infrastructure and open-source software, with the Critical Infrastructure Defense Program and free OSS Scanner.
item.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi

item.title: Episode 12: Building Effective Agent Automations
item.description: Alex and Jordan break down Anthropic's recipe for reliable scheduled agent automations.
item.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi

item.title: Episode 13: Claude Code in the Cloud: Run Tasks While Your Laptop Sleeps
item.description: Cloud sessions give each Claude Code task its own machine, branch, and credentials, so you can run work in parallel and check in from anywhere
item.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi

item.title: Episode 14: Anthropic Opens in Singapore: Safety, Trust, and a Government Pact
item.description: Alex and Jordan unpack Anthropic's Singapore office opening and its government MOU on AI safety, evaluation, and responsible adoption.
item.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi

item.title: Episode 15: Preparing for the 2026 US Midterms
item.description: Anthropic updates its election safeguards, voting information, bias testing, and misuse defenses ahead of the US midterms
item.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi

item.title: Episode 16: How the Claude Code Team Reviews Code When Agents Write Most of It
item.description: How the Claude Code team uses layered automated review, risk-based human approval, and fast rollback when agents write most of the code
item.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi

item.title: Episode 17: Independent Evaluators Inside Anthropic: Employee-Like Access and the Right to Publish
item.description: Anthropic gives METR employee-like access to assess frontier model risks, with SecureBio, Accenture and a three-tier system for other evaluators
item.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi

item.title: Episode 18: Investing in the Public Benefit: A Fund That Grows With Anthropic
item.description: Anthropic commits five percent of its shares to a new Public Benefit Fund that grows as the company grows, bringing its total public-good stake to about twenty percent.
item.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi

item.title: Episode 19: Claude Haiku 5.5: Cheaper, Faster, and Surprisingly Capable
item.description: Alex and Jordan break down Claude Haiku 5.5, Anthropic's cheapest and fastest small model, its big benchmark jumps, new effort setting, and the Sonnet cache and API credit changes that came with it.
item.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi

item.title: Episode 20: Christopher Stubbs Joins Anthropic's Trust: The Physicist Who Found the Universe Speeding Up
item.description: Alex and Jordan break down why Anthropic added Harvard physicist Christopher Stubbs, who helped discover the accelerating expansion of the universe, to the Long-Term Benefit Trust that can appoint a majority of its board.
item.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi

item.title: Episode 21: Agent Skills Gets a Neutral Home: Anthropic Donates the Standard to the Agentic AI Foundation
item.description: Alex and Jordan break down Anthropic's donation of Agent Skills to the Agentic AI Foundation: one million published skills, more than seventy platforms, and what vendor-neutral governance means for builders.
item.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi

item.title: Episode 22: Anthropic's Open Call for Guest Investigators in the Life Sciences
item.description: Anthropic invites principal investigators and their research groups to collaborate directly with its researchers for eight to twelve weeks on biology, drug discovery, and clinical science questions.
item.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi

item.title: Episode 23: Anthropic Files Its S-1 for a Proposed IPO
item.description: Alex and Jordan break down Anthropic's S-1 filing for a proposed Nasdaq IPO under the symbol ANT, with share count and price still to be determined.
item.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi

item.title: Episode 24: Spending Your Effort in Claude Code
item.description: Alex and Jordan break down Anthropic's guide to effort levels in Claude Code: what effort changes, when verification pays, and how to choose low, medium, high, or max.
item.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi

item.title: Episode 25: Claude Goes Drug Hunting: Early Progress on Faster Drug Development
item.description: Alex and Jordan break down Anthropic's life sciences update: six partners using Claude across drug development, from shorter CAR T designs and thirty-five thousand antibody candidates to an eighty-nine percent cut in manufacturing review time.
item.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi

item.title: Episode 26: How Claude Made Claude.ai 3x Faster in Two Weeks
item.description: Claude ran a two-week performance sprint in one Slack channel and made claude.ai about three times faster, merging over three thousand changes with no incidents.
item.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi

item.title: Episode 27: AI for Science Expands: Anthropic Brings the Institutions In
item.description: Anthropic expands its AI for Science program to twenty foundations, institutions, and research projects, giving away Claude credits to speed up discovery from fly brains to climate models.
item.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi

item.title: Episode 28: Expanding the GSA Partnership: Claude for All Levels of Government
item.description: Anthropic expands its GSA partnership with a forty percent discount on Claude for government partners at every level, with an estimated one billion dollars in savings.
item.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi

item.title: Episode 29: Stopping the Copycats: Anthropic's New Defenses Against Distillation Attacks
item.description: Anthropic cut reasoning-data harvesting by distillers by about 90 to 99 percent with preserved thinking, a two-stage classifier, and account bans, and argues every frontier lab and platform must do the same.
item.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi

item.title: Episode 30: Getting the Most Out of Opus 5.5 in Claude and Claude Code
item.description: Alex and Jordan walk through the claude.dev guide to prompting Opus 5.5, steering long Claude Code runs, and checking the results.
item.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi

item.title: Episode 31: Proving Which Model Really Answered: Anthropic's FlashProve
item.description: Alex and Jordan break down Anthropic's FlashProve progress on provable inference, cryptographic proofs that a response came from the claimed model, at 110 tokens per second on a 400B model.
item.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi

item.title: Episode 32: Claude Opus 5.5: Fable-Level Work, Forty Percent Cheaper
item.description: Opus 5.5 matches Fable 5.1 on most work, costs 40% less to run than Opus 5, and launches with Fable-class safeguards and the best alignment audit scores Anthropic has recorded.
item.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi

item.title: Episode 33: The Vault Mystery: Claude Maps a Particle No One Understands
item.description: Anthropic's biology lab used Claude to solve the first three dimensional structure of a vault particle in prokaryotic cells, cutting isolation from three days to ninety minutes while the particle's function remains unknown.
item.itunes:author: TheJoyDigi
